sql.if: WHERE username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password_hash, nickname, email, role, status, auth_version) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{role}, #{status}, #{authVersion})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET nickname = #{nickname}, email = #{email}, gmt_modified = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_user SET password_hash = #{newHash}, auth_version = auth_version + 1, gmt_modified = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND password_hash = #{oldHash}
UPDATE sys_user SET status = #{status}, auth_version = auth_version + 1, gmt_modified = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND role = 'USER'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_user ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
